description: The CLOSED allowlist of repositories the MYTHOS bridge may delegate work to OTHER than the control repository. A target that is not spelled out here does not exist for the delegation lane: there is no wildcard, no pattern and no environment override. The control repository is refused as a target by construction (it is the bridge's own checkout and runs through the normal worktree path). No credential of any kind belongs in this file — the host's own Git identity authenticates, and lib/cross-repo.js refuses a remote that carries userinfo.

othoth77/spy.description: SPY V2. Default branch is master, NOT main — the lane reads it from here rather than assuming. push_enabled is false: the governance relay (mythos-git-push.timer) delivers refs/heads/mythos/* of the CONTROL repository only, so a delegated run commits in its own workspace and delivery to GitHub is the owner step documented in docs/MYTHOS_CROSS_REPO_DELEGATION.md. While it is false the lane installs a no-push guard on the workspace remote, so an instructed or accidental `git push` cannot reach GitHub.
